stem: Brown-black pigment associated with acidic formalin is:
rationale: Acid formalin hematin forms in acidic formalin, especially in blood-rich tissue.

distractor_rationales.A: Hemosiderin is an iron-storage pigment and is not produced by acidic formalin.
distractor_rationales.C: Melanin is an endogenous pigment and is not the brown-black artifact formed by acidic formalin.
distractor_rationales.D: Carbon is an exogenous pigment and is unrelated to formalin hematin formation.

learning_objective: Recognize formalin hematin as the brown-black pigment associated with acidic formalin.
